{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to only completed orders (non-refunded)
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue = '999999.99') in completed orders
qa_in_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_in_completed)}")
print(f"QA order details: {qa_in_completed[['order_id', 'revenue', 'status', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age']]}")

# Confirm the max revenue
print(f"Max revenue in completed orders: {completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float).max()}")

# Apply correction: filter out QA orders
valid_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Convert revenue to float
valid_completed['revenue_numeric'] = valid_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue_corrected = valid_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of valid completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue_corrected}")

# Final count
num_valid_completed = len(valid_completed)
print(f"Number of valid completed orders: {num_valid_completed}")"}
